messages:
Harper (Demand): Planning note: webinar on 2026-04-12 17:00 PT. Need X + LinkedIn teaser push. Two creative tracks: 'Signal' (metrics + micro-chart) and 'Story' (engineer quote + outcome). Want two 4-tweet microthreads, a LinkedIn long post, hero PNG, 20s silent clip, and a GIF. Also want short reply scripts and SDR routing for high-intent comments. Can we slot this into next week's schedule?

Zoe (Social): I can own scheduling + community replies. Proposal (UTC): X Signal -> 2026-04-08T16:30Z, LinkedIn Story -> 2026-04-09T19:30Z, X Story -> 2026-04-10T16:30Z, LinkedIn Signal -> 2026-04-11T19:30Z. Will pin top reply with reg link for 48h and do two proactive replies in the first 24h. Shortlink: rdw.ai/live0426.

Mina (Content): I'll draft both X threads (4 tweets each), LinkedIn long + TL;DR, and three reply templates (info, technical, SDR handoff). Upload ETA: 2026-04-01 13:00 PT to /Marketing/Events/webinar-apr-2026/assets. Assets: hero_1200x628_v3.png, clip20s_silent.mp4, gif_tease_v1.gif. Keeping clip music-free to avoid licensing delays.

Dylan (Growth): Routing plan: webhook -> HubSpot. Pipeline: webinar_social_live0426. Triage: regex /(pricing|demo|enterprise|pilot|poc|rfp)/i -> high-intent. Also flag if author bio contains company domain or follower_count>800 -> medium. I'll add HubSpot tags source=webinar_social_0426 and variant=signal|story. Propose auto-DM exact-match for demo/pricing: "Thanks! Please DM your work email or register rdw.ai/live0426 and our SDR will follow up."

Kai (Ops): Maintenance window 2026-04-07 08:00-12:00 UTC  avoid scheduling. Confirm music/license checks by 2026-04-02. Consent checkbox enabled on reg form: TRUE. amp-bot: trigger privacy check for clip usage.

Zoe (Social): Engagement play: 1) Pin top reply with registration link for 48h, 2) Within 6h reply with a slide image + 1 stat, 3) Within 24h reply with CTA to book or watch recording. We'll mute obvious spam and set a filter for replies with external links not matching rdw.ai. Also coordinating two partner amplifiers for 4/09 morning.

Mina (Content): Reply templates (pick per signal): - Low-intent: "Thanks! Register: rdw.ai/live0426  recording sent to registrants." - Technical: "Great Q  we cover kernel & routing tradeoffs in the demo. Slides: rdw.ai/slides0426" - Sales-handoff: "Sounds like a fit  can our SDR reach out? DM your email or register and we'll fast-track follow-up."

Dylan (Growth): Regex snippet for webhook filter: ```
/(pricing|demo|enterprise|pilot|poc|rfp|purchase)/i
```
I'll implement in the webhook and share mapping with SDR leads today.

Harper (Demand): Great. Action items: Mina uploads drafts + assets by 2026-04-01 13:00 PT; Zoe queues posts and shares queue links; Dylan pushes webhook->HubSpot mapping; Kai confirms clip/license by 2026-04-02. Quick check 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Thanks team! :rocket:
